scenarios.name: prefilled-commarea-overwritten
scenarios.why: CA-CUSTOMER-REQUEST arrives full of junk: the nine SELECTed fields are replaced, CA-NUM-POLICIES ('123') and CA-POLICY-DATA are left as they came

scenarios.name: not-found-keeps-prefill
scenarios.why: +100 with a filled COMMAREA: '01' and every customer byte unchanged

scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: ' NO COMMAREA RECEIVED', WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE LINKs LGSTSQ (TD CSMT and TS GENAERRS: #4607), then ABEND LGCA

scenarios.name: short-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 60 < 90 (WS-CUSTOMER-LEN + the header and trailer): CA-RETURN-CODE '98' and RETURN, no SELECT

scenarios.name: select-fails-deadlock
scenarios.why: SQLCODE -913 (deadlock or timeout) on the SELECT: CA-RETURN-CODE '01' like not found, the customer fields untouched

scenarios.name: select-fails-other
scenarios.why: any other negative SQLCODE (-811 here): '90', WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE LINKs LGSTSQ with ERROR-MSG (the clock stamp and the WRITEQ are X6: written padded, ASSUMED): the whole task is compared

notes: Generated-row sibling (#4507) of genapp-lgicdb01: the ten CUSTOMER rows (numbers 1..10) are generated from base/cntl/db2cre.jcl (CHAR / DATE boundary values, short values, blanks; the generator is seeded), not GenApp's INSERTs. LGICDB01 SELECTs nine nullable columns INTO host variables with no indicator, so a generated NULL would answer SQLCODE -305 and take the '90' path (WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE stamps ASKTIME / FORMATTIME and LINKs LGSTSQ, whose WRITEQ is X6: oracle_assumptions.md): those nine columns are generated with "null": false, the other path stays with the stated scenarios of genapp-lgicdb01. 16 generated requests draw CA-CUSTOMER-NUM from the generated numbers, a quarter of the time a number the rows do not hold (+100, '01'), with the request id varied (LGICDB01 never tests it). The two stated scenarios keep the COMMAREA bytes the SELECT does not replace. Not generated, stated instead: EIBCALEN 0 (no-commarea), EIBCALEN < 90 ('98', short-commarea) and an injected -913 / -811 on the SELECT (line 169; '01' and '90'). See genapp-lgicdb01 for the program and COMMAREA notes.
